spec.definitions:
inductive ResidualSign | resolved (b : Bool) | unresolved

def verifierPass : ResidualSign → Bool
  | .resolved b => b
  | .unresolved => false

def r012_residual : ResidualSign := .unresolved
spec.conclusion: verifierPass r012_residual = false ∧ ∀ (cfg : ResidualSign), cfg = ResidualSign.unresolved → verifierPass cfg = false
spec.proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [verifierPass, r012_residual]
  · intro cfg h
    subst h
    rfl
